verification.note: Own article read in scoped passages: pp. 29–32 on double-edged pluralism and women’s activism; pp. 35–42 on ethnic cultural assertion, mediated case files, parental negotiation and contradictory marital/gender ideals. Case files are mediated, outcomes often unknown, and the Institute primarily served European newcomers; no universal account of all immigrants or complete monograph reading is asserted.
